The round-2 change remains correct and complete. Repository text is sanitized and capped before logging; all other collector-controlled values are represented only by type. The hoisted repository regex is equivalent to the prior inline validation. The self-tests use independent literal inputs and expected messages and cover container, row, repository, depth, sanitization, suppression, budget independence, absent-key, valid-row, and mixed-row paths while preserving complete diagnostic ordering. No trust check, audit binding, or fail-closed behavior is weakened. With no findings in either round, progress is stagnant under the required scale rather than improving.
